name: Isekai de Ore wa Ero Keiei no Top ni Naru!
original_name: 異世界で俺はエロ経営のトップになる!
source:
After dying in an accident in modern-day Japan, the protagonist is reincarnated as Kurt Lamelz, the youngest son of a noble family in another world.  
Dreaming of becoming the strongest in this new world, he’s devastated when the skill granted to him by the gods upon adulthood turns out to be “Prank Magic”—a seemingly useless ability.  
Shunned by his family and exiled to a remote area, he’s eventually abandoned altogether.  
Realizing he’ll only continue to fall further into ruin, the protagonist decides to use his modern knowledge to create and sell things that don’t exist in this world.  
Taking advantage of his single life back in Japan, he focuses on the erotic goods he’d stockpiled and starts selling them like crazy… aiming to become the greatest merchant in the world.  
And so begins a tale of rising from the bottom!..

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013347.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公在现代日本因事故身亡后，转世为异世界贵族最小的儿子库尔特·拉梅尔兹。
梦想着成为这个新世界的最强者的他，当成年后诸神赐予他的技能竟然是“恶作剧魔法”——一种看似无用的能力时，他感到非常沮丧。
他遭到家人的排斥，并被流放到偏远地区，最终被彻底抛弃。
意识到自己只会进一步陷入毁灭，主角决定利用他的现代知识来创造和出售这个世界上不存在的东西。
他利用在日本的单身生活，专注于自己储存的情色商品，并开始疯狂出售它们……目标是成为世界上最伟大的商人。
一个从底层崛起的故事就这样开始了！
